auditor_maya: Hi team — ISO auditor here. For next-week fieldwork we need a bundled artifact proving the emergency RBAC elevation on 2025-02-12 was scoped to CVE-2025-0456 triage. Requested: 1) IAM change record (who applied/reverted), 2) KMS operations for key alias/redwood-sec-ops (keyId=aa11bb22-3333), 3) the vuln ticket SEC-2025-1022, and 4) a short mapping doc to ISO controls. Can you package and provide checksums?

josh_ops: Got it. Change was a one-hour bind of svc-emergency -> infra-admin. I'll pull CloudTrail events and the GitOps merge that caused it.

emma_sec: KMS activity noted around 2025-02-12T09:12Z (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt). I'll export CloudTrail JSON for aa11bb22-3333 and a CSV summary.

tina_oncall: Quick Splunk query I used (will export raw + redact IPs):
```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com OR eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/svc-emergency" earliest="2025-02-12T08:30:00" latest="2025-02-12T10:30:00"
| table _time, eventName, eventID, requestParameters, userIdentity
```
I'll upload redacted snapshots to s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/SEC-2025-1022/ by EOD.

compliance-bot: Notice: automated detection flagged gitops/pr#6129 as the emergency change source at 2025-02-12T09:05:14Z.

emma_sec: Auditor — originals are sensitive (contains internal IPs). We can provide redacted package first and grant secure NDA access to originals. We'll include a redaction script and SHA256 of originals in the manifest.

auditor_maya: Redacted first is fine. Please include originals' SHA256 and the redaction rules in the manifest. Also include eventIDs so we can cross-check CloudTrail.

josh_ops: Packaging plan: manifest.csv (filename, sha256, eventID), mapping.md (ISO control -> artifact), redaction.sh, redacted/ and originals/ folders. We'll tar.gz redacted package and post checksum + HMAC.

tina_oncall: ETA: upload redacted tar to s3://redwood-compliance/packages/SEC-2025-1022-redacted.tar.gz by 18:00 PST. I'll post sha256 when done.

emma_sec: I'll attach a short narrative: timeline + reason KMS ops were used (decrypting ephemeral forensic blobs during triage).

auditor_maya: Thanks — ping when checksums are posted and we'll schedule secure review for originals under NDA.

josh_ops: Uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/packages/SEC-2025-1022-redacted.tar.gz
sha256: 9f1c3a7b4e5d6c2b1a0f8e7d6c5b4a3e2f1d0c9b8a7e6f5d4c3b2a190f0e1d2c
HMAC(manifest): hmac-sha256: b3c9e1f2a4d5c6b7890e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2

auditor_maya: Received — scheduling reviewer access for originals. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
